about_the_game:
Welcome to Neden, a semi-realistic virtual world where science fiction meets magic. Socialize with others, explore vast landscapes, and test your skills in various combat modes. This demo version is your first chance to experience a taste of the full game.

Build your own world

Build your own private space with items acquired in other game modes. Whether your style is a Viking cabin or a mansion with a pool. You can build together with other users in your own private space, you choose who you want to share your world with.

New friends

Enter non-game maps, where you can relax and talk with people from all over the world while discovering new friends.

You can upload your favorite images to the billboards scattered around the city of Neden, so you can show everyone what you like. You can even think about advertising your website or business!

Many game modes

Whether you prefer to fight or go in search of new items, try out one of these game modes:

Game modes available with the demo

Deathmatch:

Play 1v1 or in teams. Choose your favorite weapon set and jump into the match. Reach the objective first before time runs out and wipe out your opponents!

Private Land:

Purchase a land slot on the map to build alone or with friends.

AD Panel:

Upload your own images to the billboards scattered around the city of Neden and show your creations to all the other players!

Share yourself

Create your own character and customize it however you like. Let your personality shine through your avatar, your world and your actions.

Upcoming modes after release:

  • Survival Mode: Fight in PvP and PvE, craft your own weapons, and defend your base.

  • Car Racing: Compete with various vehicles on many different circuits.

  • Global Missions: Complete global missions to unlock new in-game features for all players.

  • Customization: Create your own custom textures for character clothing.

  • Future VR Support: Potential for VR support in the future!

content_descriptors.notes:
Because you can interact with other people in game with voice-chat or text-chat, some users may use trash talk or explicit sexual language.

Due to the game modes (survival, deathmatch, battle royal and so on) there is the possibility to kill other players and NPC with rifles and weapons.
In the social maps (non-game maps) you can not kill other users, but you can still equip some weapons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7500, AMD Ryzen™ 5 3400G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Playable on HDD with Mid quality settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-9700, AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600XT
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 24 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not for demo version
  • Additional Notes: Playable on SSD with High quality settings.
